Statements.SQL: WITH "foundry_write_source" ("foundry_source_key") AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT "foundry_model_translations"."key" AS "foundry_source_key" FROM "foundry_model_translations" WHERE ("foundry_model_translations"."scope" = $1) ORDER BY "foundry_model_translations"."key" ASC LIMIT $2) DELETE FROM "foundry_model_translations" USING "foundry_write_source" WHERE ("foundry_model_translations"."scope" = $3) AND ("foundry_model_translations"."key" = "foundry_write_source"."foundry_source_key")
